title: Blake Street Tavern- Denver, Georgia
author: madwire
excerpt: JAMMIN’ DJ’s has partnered up with Blake Street Tavern to unleash the best way to spend a Friday night: Retro Night! DJ Craig will be playing 70s, 80s, and 90s music from 9-2pm. Come check out the great drink specials, friendly staff, and light-up dance floor! We look forward to seeing you there!
